dispositions.topic_text: Accepted port syntax and range and handling of invalid values
dispositions.what: The port is decimal digits from 1 to 65535; anything else ends the start.

dispositions.topic_text: Accepted timezone setting values and handling of absent, empty, or invalid values
dispositions.what: An empty time zone counts as absent; a value the time zone database does not know ends the start.

dispositions.topic_text: Timezone use when converting camera timestamps, including DST edge cases and explicit offsets
dispositions.what: The time zone database shipped in the image is the authority for valid identifiers.
